cohort: The study included samples from 134 women (34 with placental malaria and 100 without) who were enrolled at delivery at the Marie Reine Health Center in Yaounde, Cameroon between June 2013 and October 2018.
finding: Plasmodium falciparum placental malaria was associated with increased plasma CXCL-13 and CXCL-16, and lower CXCL-4 and CCL-24 levels; additionally, birth weight was lower for babies from women with high peripheral CXCL-13 and low cord CXCL-4 and CCL-24.
